description: Minimal hand-derived smoke fixture: one density sink (particle 0, water-like O) and one density source (particle 1, Ca2+-like ion). Directly reproduces PLAN_LocalCWLDForce_OpenMM_Plugin.md section 46. Generated by independent scalar arithmetic (tanh/pow, no OpenMM Context, no MD run) -- see docs/decisions/DEC-030-two-particle-fixture.md for the derivation and verification method. Not a substitute for the six other LCWLD-030 fixtures, which require an actual OpenMM installation to generate/cross-check against CustomGBForce and are not yet produced (see tests/fixtures/README.md).

generator.note: Values were independently recomputed with plain Python math (no openmm import) and matched the plan's published golden values to full float64 precision before being copied into this file. Do not hand-edit any 'expected' value without re-deriving it the same way and updating this note.

particles.comment: water-O-like response sink; not a density source
Ca2+-like fixed-charge density source; not a response sink

finite_difference_dEdr_total.note: -(E(r+h)-E(r-h))/(2h) evaluated on E(r) as a function of the scalar pair separation; sign matches force-on-particle-0-along-unit_0_to_1, magnitude converges to dEdr_total.

variants_required_by_plan_section_46.same_residue_id: set both particles' residue_id to 0 -> density and tanh/Q terms must become 0 for particle 0 (no density edge), but Local pair energy/force are UNCHANGED unless an explicit exclusion is also added (see plan section 49 same-residue/exclusion truth table). Not yet encoded as a separate fixture file.
variants_required_by_plan_section_46.explicit_exclusion: add addExclusion(0,1) -> density, Local pair energy, direct force and chain force must all be exactly 0. Not yet encoded as a separate fixture file.
variants_required_by_plan_section_46.source_weight_halved: particle 1 source_class_weight 2.0 -> 1.0: density halves, Q0/energy/force change accordingly (not yet re-derived here).
variants_required_by_plan_section_46.sink_source_weight_irrelevant: particle 0 source_class_weight is 0 and must stay irrelevant to density since particle 0 is not a source in this fixture direction.
variants_required_by_plan_section_46.status: TODO: these four variants are described qualitatively in the plan but not yet re-derived to full numeric precision; do not treat this fixture file as covering them.
